      "most_likely_effort": 12

      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "U6: Make removal functions tolerant of non-existent values",
      "activity_description": "Modify all RemoveXXX functions to return nil error when attempting to remove a value that doesn't exist.       "most_likely_effort": 4

    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "U7: Improve GoDoc documentation and examples",
      "activity_description": "Remove unnecessary examples (listed in specification). Rename Example_systemChannel and similar functions to more descriptive names.       "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "U8: Develop demo CLI for configtx library",
      "activity_description": "Design CLI structure with cobra framework. Implement commands: configtx update, configtx generate (for genesis blocks, channel creation transactions).       "most_likely_effort": 10
    }
  ],

    "most_likely_effort": 52

}
